create_gtn_graph: create a weighted finite-state graph using gtn.Graph with add_node and add_arc methods
create_scalar_graph: create a scalar graph from a float weight value using gtn.scalar_graph
test_graph_arithmetic: test graph addition subtraction and negation using gtn.add gtn.subtract and gtn.negate
run_backward_autograd: run backward autograd on graph operations using gtn.backward to compute gradients
compare_graphs: compare two graphs for equality or isomorphism using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
